svg.title: Black Red Orange
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed upper black and lower red-orange joined panels. Museum2016 caption reports promised gift; dimensions unknown, so comparable-size display only.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://press.philamuseum.org/embracing-the-contemporary-the-keith-l-and-katherine-sachs-collection/; source object unknown; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
